title: Simplify the whole Night Roster experience
summary: Replaces the over-compressed 47.0 composition with a calmer, simpler product system built around a slim app header, one compact selected-night component, one dominant task surface per screen and a consistent bottom dock.
changes: Retires the 47.0 corrective composition layer that forced unrelated content into oversized combined shells and caused cramped mobile layouts.
Introduces one slim institution header and one clear screen-title rhythm across Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat without turning the entire top of each screen into a single card.
Standardises selected-night context into a compact shared component with shift identity, staffing context and a single-line date control that remains readable on small phones.

Keeps the nurse's personal Night allocation, Changes workflow, personal break summary and team conversation as the dominant surface in their respective screens while secondary information visually recedes.
Rebuilds the bottom navigation as a quieter equal-weight dock with an integrated Actions control rather than a competing floating visual language.
Preserves roster calculations, staffing rules, First and Second Part semantics, Malta and DST timing, authentication, database writes, clinical colours and guarded mutation paths.
